core_obligations: Let u be a point of U and xbar a geometric point over it (proof lines 3030-3031).
Use the stalk description to write the stalk of the pullback tensored up to the etale local ring as the stalk of F at xbar (proof lines 3032-3035).
Identify the ring map as a strict henselization, hence faithfully flat (proof lines 3036-3042).
Conclude that the two stalks vanish simultaneously, i.e. the supports agree (proof lines 3043-3044).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent O_X-module F on an algebraic space X and an etale morphism varphi : U -> X from a scheme, the support of the pullback varphi^*F is the preimage of the support of F (source lines 3016-3027). The proof compares stalks at a point u of U and a geometric point over it: the stalk of the pullback tensored up to the etale local ring equals the stalk of F at that geometric point, and since the local ring map is the strict henselization it is faithfully flat, so vanishing is equivalent on the two sides.
